query:
INSERT INTO brands (id, code, name, shortName, businessType, status)
VALUES
  (1, 'huanxiduo', '环洗朵科技', '环洗朵', 'hybrid', 'active'),
  (2, 'icloush-lab', 'iCloush LAB.', 'LAB', 'hybrid', 'active'),
  (3, 'astro', '浣星司 / ASTRO', 'ASTRO', 'hybrid', 'active'),
  (4, 'icloush-care', 'iCloush Care', 'Care', 'hybrid', 'active')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), shortName = VALUES(shortName), businessType = VALUES(businessType), status = VALUES(status);

INSERT INTO productCategories (brandId, name, slug, sortOrder, status)
VALUES (1, '酒店布草洗护', 'linen-care', 10, 'active')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), sortOrder = VALUES(sortOrder), status = VALUES(status);

INSERT INTO products (brandId, categoryId, productType, code, name, slug, series, subtitle, description, unit, price, image_url, specs, status, seoTitle, seoDescription)
VALUES (
  1,
  (SELECT id FROM productCategories WHERE brandId = 1 AND slug = 'linen-care' LIMIT 1),
  'physical',
  'HXD-LINEN-01',
  '环洗朵高浓缩洁净剂',
  'huanxiduo-linen-01',
  'FC',
  '酒店布草洗护 / 样板商品',
  '面向酒店布草与制服洗护场景的环洗朵样板商品，已接入多品牌货架、PDP 与零售下单链路。',
  '桶',
  680,
  'https://cdn.example.com/hxd-linen-01.webp',
  JSON_ARRAY(
    JSON_OBJECT('key', '适用场景', 'value', '酒店布草洗护'),
    JSON_OBJECT('key', '建议起订', 'value', '6 桶起订'),
    JSON_OBJECT('key', '__retail_payment_mode', 'value', 'sandbox'),
    JSON_OBJECT('key', '__retail_detail_image_urls', 'value', 'https://cdn.example.com/hxd-linen-01-detail-1.webp\nhttps://cdn.example.com/hxd-linen-01-detail-2.webp')
  ),
  'active',
  '环洗朵高浓缩洁净剂｜酒店布草洗护样板商品',
  '环洗朵样板商品，验证多品牌后台上架后可进入统一货架与商品详情页。'
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  productType = VALUES(productType),
  name = VALUES(name),
  series = VALUES(series),
  subtitle = VALUES(subtitle),
  description = VALUES(description),
  unit = VALUES(unit),
  price = VALUES(price),
  image_url = VALUES(image_url),
  specs = VALUES(specs),
  status = VALUES(status),
  seoTitle = VALUES(seoTitle),
  seoDescription = VALUES(seoDescription);

INSERT INTO productSkus (brandId, productId, skuCode, specName, packSize, basePrice, marketPrice, stockQty, minOrderQty, status)
VALUES (
  1,
  (SELECT id FROM products WHERE brandId = 1 AND slug = 'huanxiduo-linen-01' LIMIT 1),
  'HXD-LINEN-01-20L',
  '20L / 桶',
  '20L',
  680,
  780,
  120,
  6,
  'active'
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  specName = VALUES(specName),
  packSize = VALUES(packSize),
  basePrice = VALUES(basePrice),
  marketPrice = VALUES(marketPrice),
  stockQty = VALUES(stockQty),
  minOrderQty = VALUES(minOrderQty),
  status = VALUES(status);
